summary_en: Year-end dividend per share increased from 57.00 yen to 58.00 yen for fiscal year ending March 2027, raising total annual dividend from 114.00 yen to 115.00 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year profit forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Difference between Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Actual Results for the Second Quarter (Interim Period) of Fiscal Year Ending March 2027, Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Tokai Electronics announced an increase in its year-end dividend per share for fiscal year ending March 2027. The year-end dividend was raised from the previously forecast 57.00 yen to 58.00 yen, increasing the total annual dividend from 114.00 yen to 115.00 yen. This represents an increase of 1.00 yen per share.

The company revised upward its full-year consolidated earnings forecast in the same announcement, raising operating profit to 890 million yen from 600 million yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders to 660 million yen from 450 million yen. The improvement reflects stronger demand in the FA/machine tools and telecommunications sectors, favorable foreign exchange conditions, and the consolidation of subsidiary Seidentech Corporation, which was acquired on October 1, 2026.

The dividend increase reflects the company's policy of providing stable and sustainable dividends backed by earnings performance, supporting its strategic objective of strengthening corporate fundamentals. The company maintains a semi-annual dividend structure with payments at the second quarter and fiscal year-end.
